AGRICULTURE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #11
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Paper burning to ash
   B. Iron rusting
   C. Milk souring
   D. Ice melting to water

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Aquaculture? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Aquaculture.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Aquaculture.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Aquaculture.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Aquaculture.

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Crop Protection: Pest control? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Crop Protection: Pest control.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Crop Protection: Pest control.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Crop Protection: Pest control.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Crop Protection: Pest control.

4. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Burning crop residue every week
   B. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   C. Overgrazing continuously
   D. Removing all vegetation

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Vegetative propagation? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Vegetative propagation.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Vegetative propagation.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Vegetative propagation.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Vegetative propagation.

6. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Petrol fires have no fuel
   B. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   C. Water removes heat too quickly
   D. Water always increases oxygen

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Rearing Selected Animals? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Rearing Selected Animals.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Rearing Selected Animals.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Rearing Selected Animals.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Rearing Selected Animals.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Crop Production Structures? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Crop Production Structures.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Crop Production Structures.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Crop Production Structures.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Crop Production Structures.

9. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any substance that conducts electricity
   B. Any white crystal used in cooking
   C. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   D. A mixture of two liquids

10. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. A chemical reaction forming ash
   B. Heating until a solid melts
   C. Movement of water only across a membrane
   D. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration

11. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Producers
   B. Decomposers only
   C. Primary consumers only
   D. Tertiary consumers

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Inorganic fertilisers? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Inorganic fertilisers.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Inorganic fertilisers.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Inorganic fertilisers.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Inorganic fertilisers.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Agri- business Accounts and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Inorganic fertilisers and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Water conservation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Vegetative propagation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
